scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof for unrestricted stated family; independently constructed finite associator matrices are bounded consistency checks and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian group and arbitrary coefficient field; neither nonabelian nor infinite underlying groups nor general coefficient rings are treated. Connected and Latin cases are previously known; twisted group-ring historical equivalence remains a priority risk.
title: The three nuclei and characteristic jumps of finite Alexander quandle algebras
